adjudication.summary: Greptile P2 #4075163270: hardcoded test baseUrl must come from environment configuration before merge.
adjudication.clause: REV-2 admits active ADR authority and disallows strengthening beyond its clause. D-004 (docs/adr/npm-client/0005-npm-registry-dev-proxy.md:25-30) governs npm-client registry configuration, not every URL-shaped fixture value. AGENTS.md Architecture forbids hardcoded external URLs, but the reviewed value is unused model metadata on an exclusively local queue-admission path; this conclusion rests on the actual path and executed probe, not a blanket tests exemption. REV-12 therefore permits NOTE rather than FIX for this env-config demand. Independent critic /root/greptile_adjudication. Evidence: tools/agent-bench/src/project-resources.test.ts:373-379 disables model refresh/discovery networking; :380-400 creates the real pi session with explicit model metadata; :422-423 calls only public oracle.steer(text) and getSteeringMessages(). No oracle.prompt()/model stream is called. Pinned @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent 0.85.1 dist/core/agent-session.js:1016-1024 expands skills/templates then _queueSteer; :1046-1058 pushes text and calls agent.steer; :1209-1211 returns the queued array. Real @earendil-works/pi-agent-core dist/agent.js:173-175 only enqueues in steeringQueue. The pi baseUrl is not read by this path. The rifty side is real createAgentSession with injected external transport: project-resources.test.ts:61-65. tests/integration/fixtures/workbench-vite-consumer/src/agent-scripted-provider.ts:17-62 consumes Request bodies and returns local Response objects without any network primitive. It mocks only the external model boundary, permitted by AGENTS.md Fidelity. Executed original test unchanged: NODE_OPTIONS='--require=/private/tmp/rifty-greptile-deny-egress.cjs' pnpm exec vitest run tools/agent-bench/src/project-resources.test.ts -t 'send refusal matches the pinned pi session expansion' --project unit --maxWorkers=1 --minWorkers=1 --fileParallelism=false. Exit 0; 1 passed, 62 skipped; test 48ms; total 1.75s. Probe rejects global fetch, http(s).request/get, net.connect/createConnection/Socket.connect, tls.connect, dns.lookup/resolve. /private/tmp/rifty-greptile-deny-egress-results.jsonl records both process exits with denied: []. No network call was attempted, including calls that could have been caught and ignored. No tracked source edits. No required repair. Optional clarification only; existing test comment already explains the queue-only path. Reopen if new evidence shows this test dispatches the pi model or uses a real external endpoint.
